description: Land Acquisition - Hunuwala North, Opanayaka D/S Division, Rathnapura District and Malagala, Padukka D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and claimants, with no mention of government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or any other non-land related administrative matters. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisitions for public purposes.
